title: The Action Potential
description: A neuron fires when sodium channels open faster than potassium ones can close the gap: the voltage runs away upwards, then recovers. Down a long axon the signal leaks out through the membrane and fades over a length λ = √(r_m/r_i); wrap the axon in myelin and the leak all but stops, so the spike jumps from gap to gap, a hundred times faster. Unlocks the Neural Culture Array and Myelinated Axons.

puzzle.goal: A long axon leaks its signal through its membrane (resistance r_m per length, outward) while the current runs on along its core (resistance r_i per length). Write the length λ over which the voltage falls to 1/e.
puzzle.name: The cable equation
puzzle.ask: Find λ in metres for an axon with r_m = @{rm} Ω·m and r_i = @{ri} Ω/m.
puzzle.method: λ²·d²V/dx² = V: the leak through the wall balances the drop along the core where V falls by e each λ.
